title: Core and configs
blurb: Judges, students, evaluators, configs and data loaders.

blocks.name: slmjury
blocks.lead: SLMJury: Can Small Language Models Judge as Well as Large Ones?

about.html: 16 small judges (0.6B-14B) and six large ones (70B-122B), configured in slmjury/configs/models.yaml, on 8 closed-ended and 2 open-ended datasets, with quick and reasoned verdicts, personas, juries and debate.

blocks.name: slmjury.core.judge
blocks.lead: Judge model: evaluates student solutions with SLM judges served by vLLM.

about.html: Loads a judge once for many student-dataset pairs. Quick verdict (10 tokens) or reasoned verdict (8,192 tokens), with optional thinking mode for Qwen3 and Phi-4 reasoning models.

blocks.name: JudgeModel
blocks.sig: (model_key: str, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/judgements'), model_config: Optional[dict] = None)
blocks.summary: SLM judge for evaluating student solutions via vLLM.

body.html: `model_key is a key under judge_models or large_judge_models in models.yaml. model_config` overrides its config (strategies use it for tensor_parallel_size, memory settings and so on).

methods.name: evaluate_batch
methods.sig: (student_results: list[dict], max_tokens: int = 10, system_prompt: Optional[str] = None, prompt_style: Optional[str] = None, thinking: Optional[bool] = None, temperature: Optional[float] = None, prompt_template: Optional[str] = None) -> list[dict]
methods.summary: Judge a batch of student solutions; returns judgement dicts with parsed verdicts.

body.html: By default `max_tokens sets the prompt (PROMPT_QUICK at 10, else PROMPT_REASONED) and thinking (at 8,192, for judges with enable_thinking); prompt_style, thinking, temperature and prompt_template` override them.

methods.name: save_results
methods.sig: (results: list[dict], student_model: str, dataset: str, max_tokens: int) -> Path
methods.summary: Save judgements to `<output_dir>/<judge>/<student>_<dataset>_t<max_tokens>.json` and return the path.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.summary: Release GPU memory and clean up distributed processes.

body.html: `clear_hf_cache=True` also deletes the model's HF cache to free disk space. It defaults to False because several processes often share one HF cache, and deleting it could remove weights another process is using.

blocks.name: slmjury.core.solver
blocks.lead: Student solver: generates solutions with large student models served by vLLM.

about.html: Loads a student once and solves problems across datasets, with a prompt template per dataset type (science multiple choice has its own).

blocks.name: StudentSolver
blocks.sig: (model_key: str, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/student_solutions'), model_config: Optional[dict] = None)
blocks.summary: Generates solutions with a large student model via vLLM.

body.html: `model_key is a key under student_models in models.yaml; model_config` replaces the YAML lookup.

methods.name: solve_batch
methods.sig: (problems: list[dict], dataset_name: str, num_samples: Optional[int] = None) -> list[dict]
methods.summary: Solve a dataset's problems (the first `num_samples` if given); returns one result dict per problem.

body.html: `dataset_name` picks the prompt template.

methods.name: save_results
methods.summary: Save student solutions to `<output_dir>/<student>/<dataset>.json` and return the path.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.summary: Release GPU memory and clean up distributed processes.

body.html: `clear_hf_cache=True` also deletes the model's HF cache; it defaults to False (see JudgeModel.cleanup).

blocks.name: calculate_accuracy
blocks.summary: Accuracy of a set of student results against their ground-truth answers.

body.html: Returns correct, valid (an answer was extracted), total, accuracy and accuracy_pct; `dataset_name` picks the comparison.

blocks.name: save_accuracy_summary
blocks.sig: (accuracy_data: dict, model_key: str, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/summaries')) -> Path
blocks.summary: Merge one student's per-dataset accuracy into `<output_dir>/student_accuracy.json` and return its path.

blocks.name: recalculate_accuracy_from_files
blocks.summary: Rebuild `<output_dir>/student_accuracy.json` from the saved solution files, without rerunning inference.

body.html: Reads `<solutions_dir>/<student>/*.json`.

blocks.name: slmjury.core.evaluator
blocks.lead: Judge evaluator — computes accuracy, IFR, and disagreement metrics.

about.html: Evaluates judge verdicts against ground truth using dataset-appropriate answer comparison. Supports per-file evaluation and cross-file aggregation.

blocks.name: JudgeEvaluator
blocks.sig: (judge_model: str, student_model: str, dataset: str, max_tokens: int, judgements: list[dict])
blocks.summary: Scores one judgement file against the ground truth: accuracy, IFR and disagreements.

body.html: Accuracy is the share of verdicts that match the expected verdict, and IFR (instruction following rate) the share of valid verdicts. Takes the judge, student, dataset, budget and the judgement dicts.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.summary: Run evaluation and compute all metrics.
methods.returns: Summary dict with accuracy, IFR, counts, and timestamp.

methods.name: save_results
methods.summary: Save the evaluation, with disagreement details, to `<output_dir>/<judge>/<student>_<dataset>_t<n>.json`.

body.html: `output_dir` defaults to results/core/evaluations. Returns the saved path.

blocks.name: generate_judge_summary
blocks.sig: (judge_model: str, max_tokens: int, eval_dir: Optional[Path] = None, output_dir: Optional[Path] = None) -> Optional[dict]
blocks.summary: Aggregate every per-file evaluation of one judge at one budget into a summary.

body.html: Returns the summary (overall, and per dataset and student) after saving it to `output_dir`, or None when no evaluation files are found.

blocks.name: parse_judgement_filename
blocks.summary: Split a judgement filename or path, `{student}_{dataset}_t{n}.json`, into (student, dataset, max_tokens).

body.html: Raises ValueError when the name does not match.

blocks.name: list_judge_models
blocks.summary: Names of the judge subfolders in `judgements_dir` (empty if it does not exist).

blocks.name: evaluate_judge_with_tokens
blocks.sig: (judge_model: str, max_tokens: int, judgements_dir: Path = Path('results/core/judgements'), output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/evaluations'))
blocks.summary: Evaluate every judgement file of one judge at one budget and save the results under `output_dir`.

blocks.name: slmjury.core.scoring_judge
blocks.lead: Scoring judge: scores open-ended tasks with numbers instead of Correct/Incorrect verdicts.

about.html: SummEval gets all 4 dimensions (coherence, consistency, fluency, relevance) in one call; MT-Bench gets one 1-5 score for response quality. Uses the same vLLM setup as JudgeModel, with scoring prompts.

blocks.name: ScoringJudge
blocks.sig: (model_key: str, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/scoring'), model_config: Optional[dict] = None)
blocks.summary: SLM judge for scoring open-ended tasks via vLLM.

body.html: `model_key is a key under judge_models or large_judge_models in models.yaml; model_config` overrides its config.

methods.name: score_summeval
methods.sig: (summeval_data: list[dict], max_tokens: int = 8192, system_prompt: Optional[str] = None, prompt_template: Optional[str] = None) -> list[dict]
methods.summary: Score SummEval pairs on all 4 dimensions; returns dicts with the judge's score per dimension.

body.html: `system_prompt adds a system message (a persona, for example). prompt_template` replaces PROMPT_SUMMEVAL and takes the same {source_text} and {summary} fields.

methods.name: score_mtbench
methods.sig: (mtbench_data: list[dict], max_tokens: int = 8192, system_prompt: Optional[str] = None, prompt_template: Optional[str] = None) -> list[dict]
methods.summary: Score each MT-Bench 2-turn conversation as a whole on a 1-5 scale; returns dicts with judge_score.

body.html: Uses the reference models' prompt, so the correlation compares like with like. `prompt_template` replaces PROMPT_MTBENCH and takes the same turn1_question, turn1_response, turn2_question and turn2_response fields.

methods.name: save_results
methods.sig: (results: list[dict], dataset: str, suffix: str = '') -> Path
methods.summary: Save scoring results to `<output_dir>/<judge>/<dataset>[_<suffix>].json` and return the path.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.summary: Release GPU memory, and delete the model's HF cache if `clear_hf_cache` is True.

body.html: It defaults to False; see JudgeModel.cleanup.

blocks.name: slmjury.core.scoring_evaluator
blocks.lead: Scoring evaluator: correlation-based metrics for open-ended evaluation.

about.html: Compares judge scores with the ground truth (human scores for SummEval, reference-model scores for MT-Bench): Pearson, Spearman, Cohen's kappa and accuracy after thresholding, and MSE for calibration.

blocks.name: evaluate_scores
blocks.sig: (judge_scores: list[Optional[float]], ground_truth: list[float], threshold: int = 4) -> dict
blocks.summary: Every correlation metric between judge scores and ground-truth scores.

body.html: Pairs whose judge score is None (a parse failure) are left out. Returns pearson, spearman, cohens_kappa, accuracy, mse, n_valid, n_total and parse_failure_rate; `threshold` binarizes for kappa and accuracy.

blocks.name: evaluate_summeval
blocks.summary: Metrics for SummEval scoring results (from ScoringJudge.score_summeval) on all 4 dimensions.

body.html: Returns {dimension: metrics} plus an `overall` average.

blocks.name: evaluate_mtbench
blocks.summary: Metrics for MT-Bench scoring results (from ScoringJudge.score_mtbench), overall and per category.

body.html: Each question has one holistic score covering both turns, compared with the reference model's score.

blocks.name: save_evaluation
blocks.sig: (eval_result: dict, judge_model: str, dataset: str, output_dir: Path = Path('results/core/scoring_evaluations'), suffix: str = '') -> Path
blocks.summary: Save evaluation metrics to `<output_dir>/<judge>/<dataset>[_<suffix>]_eval.json` and return the path.

blocks.name: load_prompt_variants
blocks.summary: Load the judge prompt variants (`verdict_prompts and scoring_prompts`).

blocks.name: get_judge_config
blocks.sig: (model_key: str, config: dict | None = None) -> dict
blocks.summary: Return a copy of a judge's config, looked up in every judge section.

body.html: Small judges live in `judge_models; the large and ladder judges live in large_judge_models`. Raises ValueError for an unknown key.

blocks.name: load_dataset
blocks.summary: Load a dataset by name (a key of DATASET_LOADERS).

body.html: Raises DatasetLoadError when it loads no items, so a run stops before any inference.
